name: FOLFIRINOX (PRODIGE 4/ACCORD 11)

biomarkers.note: FOLFIRINOX cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted; it is a preferred category 1 first-line option for good performance status (ECOG 0 to 1) regardless of biomarker status. Tumor/somatic and germline molecular profiling (NGS) is recommended for all anti-cancer-therapy candidates to guide targeted therapy and maintenance choices: BRCA1/2 or PALB2 status supports platinum-based therapy and PARP-inhibitor maintenance; BRAF V600E (dabrafenib plus trametinib); NTRK, RET, and other fusions; HER2 amplification; and MSI-H, dMMR, or TMB-high (pembrolizumab). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN, licensed), Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma Principles of Molecular Profiling (footnote j; PANC-1A, PANC-2A) and Principles of Systemic Therapy, Metastatic Disease First-Line (PANC-G).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before oxaliplatin/irinotecan per appendix D emetic-risk tier below

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: moderate-to-high emetic risk (oxaliplatin and irinotecan are each individually moderate emetic risk IV agents per NCCN Antiemesis categories in appendix D; combining two moderately emetogenic agents on the same day is conventionally managed as the higher tier). Exact per-regimen NCCN order-template tier not yet confirmed - verify against per-disease NCCN template.

G-CSF: PRODIGE 4/ACCORD 11 reported febrile neutropenia 5.4% (vs 1.2% gemcitabine) and grade 3-4 neutropenia 45% (source lines 107088-107091). Appendix C risk tiering (High/Intermediate) for this specific regimen was not located in the provided source; use physician-patient discussion of prophylactic CSF support per appendix C intermediate-risk framework pending confirmation of the regimen's listed risk level on a per-disease NCCN template.

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: UGT1A1*28 homozygous, hepatic dysfunction, or clinically significant irinotecan-related diarrhea
doseModificationRules.text: DeVita 12th ed. (Chapter 9, irinotecan pharmacology, lines 19427 to 19433): SN-38 is glucuronidated by UGT1A1; deficiency in this pathway increases the risk of diarrhea and myelosuppression, and dose reductions are recommended for patients homozygous for the UGT1A1*28 allele (a genotyping test is available) and for hepatic dysfunction with bilirubin greater than 1.5 (DeVita line 19433). Late diarrhea (onset beyond 24 hr after irinotecan) is managed with loperamide, escalating to diphenoxylate/atropine and opium tincture if severe (lines 19421 to 19426). DeVita reports grade 3 to 4 diarrhea of 12.7% with FOLFIRINOX in PRODIGE 4/ACCORD 11 (line 107100). Note: DeVita Chapter 40 (lines 121523 to 121531) states there are currently no specific guidelines for routine dose modification on the basis of UGT1A1 polymorphism, so apply per physician judgement.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

guideline.locator: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma, Principles of Systemic Therapy, Metastatic Disease First-Line Therapy (PANC-G; FOLFIRINOX category 1, preferred for good PS ECOG 0 to 1); Principles of Molecular Profiling (footnote j; PANC-1A, PANC-2A)

provenanceNote: Earlier VERIFY-resolution (DeVita core): DeVita 12th ed. (Chapter 35) describes FOLFIRINOX for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). histology resolved to adenocarcinoma (PDAC is pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; section header on second-line therapy for metastatic PDAC at line 107126). treatmentSetting resolved to metastatic and stage to IV: DeVita establishes FOLFIRINOX (with mFOLFIRINOX) as a preferred first-line treatment for patients with metastatic PDAC (line 107122). lineOfTherapy resolved to first-line (FOLFIRINOX is recommended as first-line treatment for patients with good performance status, lines 107108 to 107109). eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status: PRODIGE 4/ACCORD 11 randomized patients with ECOG 0 to 1 (line 107087) and DeVita recommends it for good-performance-status patients (lines 107108 to 107109). An irinotecan UGT1A1 and diarrhea dose-consideration was added to doseModificationRules, sourced to DeVita Chapter 9 (lines 19421 to 19433) and the PRODIGE 4/ACCORD 11 diarrhea rate (line 107100). ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1 guideline resolution (Standard Guidelines, NCCN licensed, Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v3.2026): biomarkers resolved: the cytotoxic FOLFIRINOX backbone is not biomarker-restricted (preferred category 1 first-line for good PS regardless of biomarker), while tumor/somatic and germline molecular profiling is tested (BRCA1/2, PALB2, KRAS, BRAF, HER2, NTRK and other fusions, MSI, dMMR, TMB) to guide targeted therapy and maintenance choices (PANC molecular profiling footnote j and PANC-G). The guideline concurs with the core metastatic first-line placement and good-PS ECOG 0 to 1 eligibility, so no divergence is recorded.
